profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ClearCorrect
profile.summary: Software developer with experience in engineering visualization, research & development, computer games, and military applications. Specialties include real-time 3D graphics, numerical computing, algorithm design, user interface, and performance tuning. Shipped 8 engineering applications and 9 games.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• ClearPilot: Designed and implemented graphics and computational systems for web-based application. The application allows doctors to see and adjust aligner treatments to be manufactured.  Worked with domain experts and UI designer to improve user experience. Shipped 3 versions: Q4 2020, Q2 2021, and Q4 2021. 
• Stage: Developed graphics, geometry, math, and UI code for proprietary desktop application. Designed and implemented new geometry features including collision detection and mesh optimization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Wargaming.Net project: Worked in small R&D team to develop prototype for AR mobile military game.
• MVBench: R&D for object recognition software/hardware. Built simulator that emulated and controlled custom hardware platform. Prototype shown at SXSW 2019.
• Certain Affinity project: Graphics, UI, and gameplay programming for multiplayer AAA game developed with partner company. 
• Nightenfell:  Developed AR mobile game based on prior R&D. Wrote shaders for processing of live video and special effects. Designed and implemented localization technology. Wrote gameplay code for weapons. Shipped April 2018.
• Google Augmented Reality (AR) R&D: Developed game prototypes to research interaction techniques. Developed Surface Mimicry technology, which maps live video to virtual game objects. Built flexible board/tile editor for board game. Produced 3D artwork (terrain, trees, etc.) until a full-time artist joined the team.

positions.title: Senior 3D Graphics/Rendering Engineer
positions.description: • Developed rendering software for next generation multiplatform AR/VR game engine. Implemented instance-based rendering system. Implemented state-of-the-art Light Indexed Deferred (LID) lighting and published whitepaper about it on company website. Optimized performance of renderer on Android devices.

positions.title: Senior Client Engineer
positions.description:
• Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes: Graphics, gameplay, and UI programming for mobile collectibles combat game. Implemented fractal rendering for Force Lightning. Developed high-performance shadow and reflection system. Worked with VFX artists to add cinematics. Developed celebration screens (crafting, level up, etc.). Implemented event missions. Shipped Q4 2015.
• Heroes of Dragon Age: Graphics, gameplay and UI programming for mobile collectibles battle game. Designed and implemented celebration screens. Developed newsfeed for announcements, events, and store sales. Owned Apple-specific features including writing build scripts, in-app purchase flow changes, and art changes to meet changing iOS requirements. Released game and 4 updates in 2014.
• Monopoly Bingo: Graphics, UI, gameplay, audio, and localization programming for casual mobile game. Analyzed performance and tuned game to work well on a wide variety of devices. Worked with artists and sound engineer to develop pipeline tools and support downloadable content. Shipped Q4 2013.

positions.title: Senior Graphics Engineer
positions.description:
• Otherland: UI and gameplay programming for MMO on Windows. Worked in a 4-person team, developing a guild subsystem for a larger remote team. Shipped Q4 2015.
• Platinum Life: Country: Graphics, UI, and gameplay programming for casual Facebook game. Designed and implemented character customization system. Developed in-game jukebox, RSS viewer, and Twitter viewer. Shipped Q2 2012.
• Gods and Heroes: Rome Rising: Graphics and UI programming for MMO on Windows. Extended shadow system and wrote custom shaders for skin and armor. Developed character customization screen. Fixed bugs and added enhancements as part of live team. Shipped Q2 2011.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Graphics
positions.description: Visualization and UI programming for geology application on Linux and Windows. Designed and implemented mapping, well planning, and measurement tools. Shipped 2 releases.

positions.title: Senior Graphics Programmer
positions.description: Graphics, gameplay, AI, and UI development for 2 unreleased titles: 1) a PC MMORPG built with the Hero Engine, and 2) a bull-riding Wii game using a proprietary engine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Graphics, UI, performance, and localization programming for AAA games. Developed tools and extensions for modified Unreal engine. Shipped 2 console/PC titles: BlackSite: Area 51 and Wheelman.
